name: Late Vibrato
description: A vibrato that waits: a held note begins straight and sways more the longer it lasts, and each new note sends everything sounding back to straight.

params.name: Wait
params.description: How long a note is held before it starts to sway. Notes shorter than this pass straight through.

params.name: Grow
params.description: How long the sway takes to open from nothing to its full depth once the wait is over.

params.name: Depth
params.description: How far the pitch bends each way once the sway is fully open. Slow rates hold less of it than fast ones.

params.name: Rate
params.description: How fast the pitch sways as it begins. Slow is a drift; fast is a nervous shake.

params.name: Quicken
params.description: Speeds the sway up as it opens, the way a player presses into a long note. Zero keeps one rate throughout.

params.name: Swell
params.description: Lets level and brightness rise with the sway and pulse along with each cycle, so a held note opens up as it starts to move.

params.name: Human
params.description: Lets the rate and the depth wander slowly, so no two cycles are quite alike. Zero is a perfectly even sway.

params.name: Sense
params.description: The sway follows the newest note: each new one sends everything sounding back to straight. Low, only a note after silence counts as new; high, every touch does.

params.name: Width
params.description: Moves the right side's sway out of step with the left, so a held note spreads as it opens. Slow, deep sways are kept closer together, so the two sides still sum cleanly.

params.name: Mix
params.description: Balance between the straight sound and the swaying one. Part way, a held note opens into a chorus instead of a vibrato.

origin.note: Written for live-mix on cpp/kit. A modulated delay whose depth follows how long the sound has sustained since its last attack; the sway itself runs freely.
